main_measure.name: mean of forecast/10 x (14-bar forward return - coin's mean 14-bar return), grid cases

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases summed per day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean directional excess 14-bar return, |forecast| above median minus below

decided_by: the main mean is positive with t >= 2 and the supporting check passes
reading: Every grid bar (positions 0,14,28,... per coin and window) with a 14-bar forward return inside its window is a case, forecast 0 included; the coin's mean 14-bar return is the mean over its grid cases of all windows; the t clusters case deviations summed per UTC day (with D/(D-1) correction); the median split uses |forecast| strictly above vs strictly below the median, directional excess = sign(forecast) x excess return.
